```{r setup, echo=FALSE, message=F,include=F}
draw_diag <- function(col="#A6A6A6",alpha_value=0.75,lwd=1.5,lty=1){
  usr <- par("usr")
  x_limits <- if(isTRUE(par("xlog"))) 10^usr[1:2] else usr[1:2]
  y_limits <- if(isTRUE(par("ylog"))) 10^usr[3:4] else usr[3:4]
  line_limits <- c(max(x_limits[1],y_limits[1]),
                   min(x_limits[2],y_limits[2]))

  if(all(is.finite(line_limits)) && line_limits[1] <= line_limits[2]){
    segments(line_limits[1],line_limits[1],line_limits[2],line_limits[2],
             col=alpha(col,alpha_value),lwd=lwd,lty=lty,xpd=FALSE)
  }
  invisible(line_limits)
}

extend_plot_limits <- function(values,log_axis=FALSE,fraction=0.1){
  values <- as.numeric(values)
  values <- values[is.finite(values)]
  if(log_axis){
    values <- values[values>0]
    limits <- range(log10(values))
    span <- diff(limits)
    if(span==0) span <- 1
    return(10^(limits+c(-fraction,fraction)*span))
  }

  limits <- range(values)
  span <- diff(limits)
  if(span==0) span <- max(abs(limits),1)
  limits+c(-fraction,fraction)*span
}

# Match the parameter notation used in pdf_25_Fig2_hepG2Synergy.Rmd.
metric_label <- function(label){
  if(!is.character(label) || length(label) != 1){
    return(label)
  }

  labels <- list(
    "regP"=expression("RegP"),
    "RegP"=expression("RegP"),
    "EC50"=expression("EC"[textstyle("50")]),
    "n"=expression("n"[textstyle("H")]),
    "nH"=expression("n"[textstyle("H")]),
    "Hill coefficient"=expression("n"[textstyle("H")]),
    "Abasal"=expression("A"[textstyle("basal")]),
    "basal"=expression("A"[textstyle("basal")]),
    "basal activity"=expression("A"[textstyle("basal")]),
    "Amax"=expression("A"[textstyle("max")]),
    "Fmax"=expression("A"[textstyle("max")]),
    "max activity"=expression("A"[textstyle("max")]),
    "synergy"=expression("Synergy"),
    "Synergy"=expression("Synergy"),
    "hepG2synergy"=expression("Synergy")
  )
  if(!is.null(labels[[label]])) labels[[label]] else label
}

metric_axis_labels <- function(labels){
  as.expression(lapply(labels, function(label){
    formatted <- metric_label(label)
    if(is.expression(formatted)) formatted[[1]] else formatted
  }))
}
```

```{r , eval=TRUE, fig.width=3, fig.height=3.5, dpi=300, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='show'}

compare_minP_hsp <- function(x,x_error,bar_error,lower=0,upper=0,col="",logxy="xy",portion_cut=0.25,xlab="hsp68",ylab="minP",main="",xlabels=c(1,10,100),xat=c(1,10,100),bc_full_list=union(final_smallError,final_smallError),point_col="#9075ab"){
  hsp_tmp <- get(x)[,col,drop=FALSE]
  minP_tmp <- get(paste("mP_",x,sep=""))[,col,drop=FALSE]
hsp_tmp_error <- get(x_error)[,col,drop=FALSE]
  minP_tmp_error <- get(paste("mP_",x_error,sep=""))[,col,drop=FALSE]
  hsp_error_sum <- get(bar_error)[,col,drop=FALSE]
  minP_error_sum <- get(paste("mP_",bar_error,sep=""))[,col,drop=FALSE]

 # bc_full_list <- union(final_smallError,final_smallError) #union(final_smallError,mP_final_smallError)  # intersect(smallError_list3,mP_smallError_list3) #both_final_smallError
  plot_list <- bc_full_list[which(hsp_tmp_error[bc_full_list,]>0 & 
                                  hsp_tmp_error[bc_full_list,]<portion_cut*abs(hsp_tmp[bc_full_list,])&
                                  minP_tmp_error[bc_full_list,]>0 & 
                                  minP_tmp_error[bc_full_list,]<portion_cut*abs(minP_tmp[bc_full_list,])&
                                  hsp_tmp[bc_full_list,] < upper & hsp_tmp[bc_full_list,]>lower &
                                    minP_tmp[bc_full_list,] < upper & minP_tmp[bc_full_list,]>lower &
                                  minP_error_sum[bc_full_list,] >0 & minP_error_sum[bc_full_list,] < portion_cut*abs(minP_tmp[bc_full_list,])&
                                  hsp_error_sum[bc_full_list,] >0 & hsp_error_sum[bc_full_list,] < portion_cut*abs(hsp_tmp[bc_full_list,])
                                  )]
  #plot_list <- both_final_smallError
  x_limits <- extend_plot_limits(c(hsp_tmp[plot_list,],xat),
                                 log_axis=grepl("x",logxy,fixed=TRUE))
  y_limits <- extend_plot_limits(c(minP_tmp[plot_list,],xat),
                                 log_axis=grepl("y",logxy,fixed=TRUE))
  if(col %in% c("synergy","hepG2synergy")) x_limits[1] <- -1.2
  plot(hsp_tmp[plot_list,],minP_tmp[plot_list,],log=logxy,type="n",
       xlim=x_limits,ylim=y_limits,xaxs="i",yaxs="i",
       axes=FALSE, ann=FALSE)
  axis(2, at=xat, labels=xlabels, lwd=1, tck=-0.025,
       col=rgb(0,0,0,0), col.ticks="black", padj=1.7, cex.axis=0.8,
       gap.axis=-1)
  axis(1, at=xat, labels=xlabels, lwd=1, tck=-0.025,
       col=rgb(0,0,0,0), col.ticks="black", padj=-2, cex.axis=0.8,
       gap.axis=-1)
  title(xlab=xlab, ylab=ylab, main=metric_label(main), line=1.2, cex.lab=0.9)
  abline(h=xat, col="lightgray", lty=1, lwd=0.75)
  arrows(hsp_tmp[plot_list,]-hsp_error_sum[plot_list,], minP_tmp[plot_list,], hsp_tmp[plot_list,]+hsp_error_sum[plot_list,], minP_tmp[plot_list,], length=0, angle=90, code=3,col=point_col)
  arrows(hsp_tmp[plot_list,], minP_tmp[plot_list,]-minP_error_sum[plot_list,], hsp_tmp[plot_list,], minP_tmp[plot_list,]+minP_error_sum[plot_list,], length=0, angle=90, code=3,col=point_col)
points(hsp_tmp[plot_list,],minP_tmp[plot_list,],pch=21,cex=1,
       col=point_col,bg=alpha(point_col,0.5))
draw_diag(alpha_value=1,lwd=1.5,lty=2)
box()

    if(logxy=="xy"){
      cor_return <-cor(log(hsp_tmp[plot_list,]),log(minP_tmp[plot_list,]),use="pairwise.complete.obs")
        t_pvalue <- t.test(log(hsp_tmp[plot_list,]),log(minP_tmp[plot_list,]))$p.value
  }else{
      cor_return <- (cor((hsp_tmp[plot_list,]),(minP_tmp[plot_list,]),use="pairwise.complete.obs"))
        t_pvalue <- t.test(hsp_tmp[plot_list,],minP_tmp[plot_list,])$p.value
  }
  legend("topleft", legend=paste0("R=", round(cor_return, 2)), bty="n", cex=0.8)
  #boxplot(hsp_tmp[plot_list,],minP_tmp[plot_list,],log=logxy)
    print(paste0(col," R=",cor_return,"    t p=",t_pvalue))
    #print(paste0())
  return(cor_return)
}

one_cell_line <- function(name1,name2,name3,synergy=FALSE,lower_,upper_,point_col="#9075ab",
                          ec50_at=(c(10,25,75)^2),ec50_labels=c(10,25,75)){
  tmp_cor_df <- data.frame(EC50=NA,nH=NA,Abasal=NA,Amax=NA,regP=NA,synergy=NA,hepG2synergy=NA)
tmp_cor_df$EC50 <- compare_minP_hsp(x=name1,x_error=name2,bar_error=name3,col="Kd",lower=lower_,upper=upper_,main="EC50",xat=ec50_at,xlabels=ec50_labels,bc_full_list=bc_full_list,portion_cut=0.5,point_col=point_col)
tmp_cor_df$nH <- compare_minP_hsp(x=name1,x_error=name2,bar_error=name3,col="n",lower=.1,upper=10,logxy="xy",main="nH",xat =c(1,2,4),xlabels = c(1,2,4),bc_full_list = bc_full_list,point_col=point_col)
tmp_cor_df$regP <- compare_minP_hsp(x=name1,x_error=name2,bar_error=name3,col="regP",lower=-Inf,upper=Inf,portion_cut=Inf,logxy="",main="regP",xat =c(0,4,8),xlabels = c(0,4,8),point_col=point_col)
tmp_cor_df$Abasal <- compare_minP_hsp(x=name1,x_error=name2,bar_error=name3,col="basal",lower=-Inf,upper=Inf,logxy="xy",main="Abasal",xat =c(0.2,1,5,25,125),xlabels = c(0.2,1,5,25,125),point_col=point_col)
tmp_cor_df$Amax <- compare_minP_hsp(x=name1,x_error=name2,bar_error=name3,col="Fmax",lower=-Inf,upper=Inf,logxy="xy",main="Amax",xat =c(1,10,100,1000),xlabels = c(1,10,100,1000),point_col=point_col)
if(synergy){tmp_cor_df$synergy <- compare_minP_hsp(x=name1,x_error=name3,bar_error=name3,col="synergy",lower=-Inf,upper=Inf,portion_cut=Inf,logxy="",main="synergy",xat =c(-3,0,3,6),xlabels = c(-3,0,3,6),point_col=point_col)
tmp_cor_df$hepG2synergy <- compare_minP_hsp(x=name1,x_error=name3,bar_error=name3,col="hepG2synergy",lower=-Inf,upper=Inf,portion_cut=Inf,logxy="",main="hepG2synergy",xat =c(-3,0,3,6),xlabels = c(-3,0,3,6),point_col=point_col)
}
return(tmp_cor_df)
}
```

```{r, eval=TRUE, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
hepG2_foxa1_conc <- 49.27642992
hepG2_hnf4a_conc <- 26.53009141

load_biorep_parameters <- function(param_dir){
  read_condition <- function(condition){
    lapply(1:3, function(rep_id){
      read.table(file.path(param_dir, paste0("gHill_lib1_", condition,
                                             "_trained_par_r", rep_id, ".txt")),
                 row.names=1, sep="\t", header=TRUE)
    })
  }

  rep_par <- list(k1f=read_condition("k1f"),
                  k3h=read_condition("k3h"),
                  k4fh=read_condition("k4fh"))

  for(rep_id in 1:3){
    for(condition in c("k1f", "k3h", "k4fh")){
      par_here <- rep_par[[condition]][[rep_id]]
      par_here$regP <- log2(par_here$Fmax/par_here$basal)
      rep_par[[condition]][[rep_id]] <- par_here
    }

    k1f <- rep_par$k1f[[rep_id]]
    k3h <- rep_par$k3h[[rep_id]]
    k4fh <- rep_par$k4fh[[rep_id]]
    seq_ids <- Reduce(intersect, list(row.names(k1f), row.names(k3h), row.names(k4fh)))

    predict_log2_over_basal <- function(par_table, concentration){
      activity <- par_table$basal+
        (par_table$Fmax-par_table$basal)/
        (1+(par_table$Kd^par_table$n)/(concentration^par_table$n))
      log2(activity/par_table$basal)
    }

    k4fh[seq_ids, "synergy"] <- k4fh[seq_ids, "regP"]-
      (k1f[seq_ids, "regP"]+k3h[seq_ids, "regP"])
    k4fh[seq_ids, "hepG2synergy"] <-
      predict_log2_over_basal(k4fh[seq_ids,], hepG2_foxa1_conc*hepG2_hnf4a_conc)-
      (predict_log2_over_basal(k1f[seq_ids,], hepG2_foxa1_conc)+
         predict_log2_over_basal(k3h[seq_ids,], hepG2_hnf4a_conc))
    k4fh$n <- k4fh$n*2
    rep_par$k4fh[[rep_id]] <- k4fh
  }

  list(gHill_par_foxa1_k1f=rep_par$k1f,
       gHill_par_foxa1_k3h=rep_par$k3h,
       gHill_par_foxa1_k4fh=rep_par$k4fh)
}

hsp_biorep_parameters <- load_biorep_parameters(
  path.expand("~/Dropbox/postdoc/tft_metadata/hill_fit/hessian_se"))
mP_biorep_parameters <- load_biorep_parameters(
  path.expand("~/Dropbox/postdoc/tft_metadata/hill_fit/minP_hessian_se"))

get_parameter_subset <- function(x, x_error, bar_error, col, lower, upper,
                                 portion_cut, bc_full_list){
  hsp_tmp <- get(x)[,col,drop=FALSE]
  minP_tmp <- get(paste0("mP_",x))[,col,drop=FALSE]
  hsp_tmp_error <- get(x_error)[,col,drop=FALSE]
  minP_tmp_error <- get(paste0("mP_",x_error))[,col,drop=FALSE]
  hsp_error_sum <- get(bar_error)[,col,drop=FALSE]
  minP_error_sum <- get(paste0("mP_",bar_error))[,col,drop=FALSE]

  bc_full_list[which(hsp_tmp_error[bc_full_list,]>0 &
                       hsp_tmp_error[bc_full_list,]<portion_cut*abs(hsp_tmp[bc_full_list,]) &
                       minP_tmp_error[bc_full_list,]>0 &
                       minP_tmp_error[bc_full_list,]<portion_cut*abs(minP_tmp[bc_full_list,]) &
                       hsp_tmp[bc_full_list,]<upper & hsp_tmp[bc_full_list,]>lower &
                       minP_tmp[bc_full_list,]<upper & minP_tmp[bc_full_list,]>lower &
                       minP_error_sum[bc_full_list,]>0 &
                       minP_error_sum[bc_full_list,]<portion_cut*abs(minP_tmp[bc_full_list,]) &
                       hsp_error_sum[bc_full_list,]>0 &
                       hsp_error_sum[bc_full_list,]<portion_cut*abs(hsp_tmp[bc_full_list,]))]
}

min_pairwise_biorep_R <- function(rep_tables, parameter, seq_ids, use_log){
  rep_pairs <- combn(1:3, 2)
  pairwise_R <- apply(rep_pairs, 2, function(pair_ids){
    rep_x <- rep_tables[[pair_ids[1]]][seq_ids, parameter]
    rep_y <- rep_tables[[pair_ids[2]]][seq_ids, parameter]
    if(use_log){
      rep_x <- log(rep_x)
      rep_y <- log(rep_y)
    }
    suppressWarnings(cor(rep_x, rep_y, use="pairwise.complete.obs"))
  })
  pairwise_R <- pairwise_R[is.finite(pairwise_R)]
  if(length(pairwise_R)==0) return(NA_real_)
  min(pairwise_R)
}

calculate_biorep_cor <- function(name1, name2, name3, synergy=FALSE,
                                 lower_, upper_){
  result <- data.frame(EC50=rep(NA_real_,2), nH=NA_real_, Abasal=NA_real_,
                       Amax=NA_real_, regP=NA_real_, synergy=NA_real_,
                       hepG2synergy=NA_real_, row.names=c("hsp68","minP"))

  add_parameter <- function(result, result_col, parameter, lower, upper,
                            portion_cut, use_log, x_error=name2,
                            bar_error=name3,
                            candidate_ids=union(final_smallError,final_smallError)){
    seq_ids <- get_parameter_subset(name1, x_error, bar_error, parameter,
                                    lower, upper, portion_cut, candidate_ids)
    result["hsp68",result_col] <- min_pairwise_biorep_R(
      hsp_biorep_parameters[[name1]], parameter, seq_ids, use_log)
    result["minP",result_col] <- min_pairwise_biorep_R(
      mP_biorep_parameters[[name1]], parameter, seq_ids, use_log)
    result
  }

  result <- add_parameter(result, "EC50", "Kd", lower_, upper_, 0.5, TRUE,
                          candidate_ids=bc_full_list)
  result <- add_parameter(result, "nH", "n", 0.1, 10, 0.25, TRUE,
                          candidate_ids=bc_full_list)
  result <- add_parameter(result, "regP", "regP", -Inf, Inf, Inf, FALSE)
  result <- add_parameter(result, "Abasal", "basal", -Inf, Inf, 0.25, TRUE)
  result <- add_parameter(result, "Amax", "Fmax", -Inf, Inf, 0.25, TRUE)
  if(synergy){
    result <- add_parameter(result, "synergy", "synergy", -Inf, Inf, Inf,
                            FALSE, x_error=name3, bar_error=name3)
    result <- add_parameter(result, "hepG2synergy", "hepG2synergy", -Inf,
                            Inf, Inf, FALSE, x_error=name3, bar_error=name3)
  }
  minimum_R <- vapply(result, function(values){
    if(all(is.na(values))) return(NA_real_)
    min(values, na.rm=TRUE)
  }, numeric(1))
  data.frame(as.list(minimum_R), row.names="minimum")
}
```
